detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=oci`.
• Install and configure Provider serverless monitoring via cloud TA with the modular input for `oci:functions:invocation`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.5.16.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `functionId` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Configure required cloud inputs per provider guide; index=oci sourcetype=oci:functions:invocation.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=oci sourcetype="oci:functions:invocation" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=oci sourcetype="oci:functions:invocation"
| table _time functionId status duration
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.5.24_oci_functions_invocation_24"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `oci:functions:invocation` in `index=oci` to detect oci functions invocation errors. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the provider cloud console audit view for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `functionId` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_5_24_alert` with severity aligned to `high` criticality. Dashboard: Dashboard panel, alert, and weekly compliance report..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade Provider serverless monitoring via cloud TA and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
grandmaExplanation: We watch cloud logs for signs of oci functions invocation errors so your team catches problems in your online services before customers or auditors do.
